description: PRODUCT DISCOVERY ONLY — for when the user is browsing, comparing, or exploring products and has not yet decided exactly what to buy. NOT for purchasing: if the user wants to buy / order named products from a specific merchant, do NOT call this tool — call create_search_checkout directly instead. Searches for products by name across merchants and returns ranked results each with name, brand, merchant, image, priceFrom, currency, and directUrl. Optionally narrow results to a specific merchant while still returning others. If the user later decides to order a result, pass its directUrl to create_checkout (or to get_product_details for variants).

merchant.description: Optional merchant name to prioritize results (e.g. 'amazon', "Macy's")

name: search_products
